Figure 6: Prompt for LLM-as-Judge scoring of system responses. The judge returns one {0, 0.5, 1} coverage score per aspect (aspect scores) plus a 1–5 holistic overall quality score; the 1–5 reasoning completeness reported in the main text is computed post-hoc as round(4 · w + 1), where w is the weight-normalized mean of the per-aspect coverage scores using the Likert aspect weights.
